start.step: Join an active organization on day 1.
more: Only the top 8 organizations in that week's Weekly Challenge can enter guild war.
start.source: October 19 article "Planner by server day", "If you read nothing else"

start.step: Pick one faction and stay with it.
more: Each faction has a meta team on Best teams, with its attack order.
Free-to-play: No Organization is the cheapest. Nutcracker came from the days 1–7 Wish Rebate (now closed), Sen is free, and the free No Org units all power her up.

Aogiri is just as strong but needs Black Rabbit (his Carnival is global Season 21, not this server's next one; day-75 shop listing unconfirmed) and Miza (her rate-up, guaranteed at 200 pulls, ended October 27; wait for a rerun or a Legacy Custom banner).

Both beat Anteiku and CCG after the October 14 patch. Hinami [Halloween] (October 25 on established servers; out here since October 27 per the owner) makes Anteiku strong again for players who pull her. (creator report)
link: See the meta team for each faction

start.step: Claim every free unit, then build the free team.
more: Sign-in units by server day: Enji (day 1), Yakumo [Jason] (day 5), Kureo (day 9), Kurona (day 13). If you start late, you miss some.
Sen: Unlimited Recruitment, in your first 14 days after you register.
Day-14 SSR Selection Card: take Naki [Crybaby]. Day-28 card: Shu [Gourmet].
Rize [Binge Eater]: free mission chain.
start.source: October 19 article "Meta teams", section 2 "F2P starter teams"

start.step: Save Diamonds and tickets for one banner you can finish.
more: Limited units need 300 pulls (90,000 Diamonds) to guarantee. Non-limited rate-ups, such as Miza's (now over), guarantee at 200 pulls (60,000).
Pity doesn't carry over, so never start a banner you can't finish.
Pull only for an exclusive unit in your faction (or a 0★ buff for any team) with no shop date.
On older servers, Christmas units came around day 62–76 and Uta [New Year] around day 91–98. Your server's dates may differ.

Hinami [Halloween] is the new limited Anteiku support (October 25 – November 8 on established servers, 300 pulls). The owner reports she is out on the NA relaunch server (October 27). Pull only if you play Anteiku and can finish the 300; see the New unit page.

start.step: Skip banners whose unit comes to a shop later.
more: Shop dates in the game data: Juzo [CCG Maverick] day 15, Uta [Mask-Maker] day 29, Hideyoshi and Nishiki day 75.
If the shop sells them, buy Uta [Rescue] (day 43) first, then Hideyoshi (day 75).
Which shop and the price are not confirmed. Check the shop tabs every week.

start.step: You don't have to spend. If you do, buy inside a rebate window.
more: A rebate window makes each purchase pay twice. The best one is the Diamond Rebate, server days 34–55.
Plain Diamonds are the worst value: 80 per $1 (October 19 price).

teams.title: Guild War

play.text: Build one strong team. It attacks strongholds and it is also your defense team.
Your other two teams are 1–2 characters each, used only to grab free tiles. If the game asks for 5 characters, use your 5 weakest units.
Common mistake: three medium teams that all attack. That wastes attacks.
Stronghold that never seems to die? Test a 1–2 character attack before you use a full team (if the game asks for 5 characters, use your 5 weakest units).

rows.label: Best: Aogiri team
why: Black Rabbit is DST, so he beats every attribute except another DST. Miza strips shields every turn.

Naki's LR cell: creators say it gives your highest-ATK unit an extra attack. In the game text that is Naki [Prisoner]'s LR cell (it makes your highest-ATK Aogiri ally cast too); Naki [Crybaby]'s LR cell instead lowers the target's skill level in PvP. Check which cell you have.
Yakumo [Natsu Matsuri] was weakened on October 14 (creator report). Black Rabbit and Miza are banned in Global Pinnacle Championship season 1 (creator report).
Source: research notes of October 26, 2026, section A6.

order.source: Skill text used: SkillDesc_1155_p1/p3, SkillDesc_1179_p1, SkillDesc_1036_v1s1, SkillDesc_1175_p1, SkillDesc_1166_p1; "give him the highest ATK" is from the October 19 article, section 1.
steps: Turn start is automatic: Miza strips enemy shields and chips 10% of their current HP (at most 100% of her own starting HP), and Black Rabbit hits everyone for 180%.
Naki first: his hit lowers the target's skill levels.
Black Rabbit's skill next (265% to all). At 3★, every Aogiri cast powers him up.
Miza's skill on the biggest threat: it ignores shields and DEF.
Yakumo [Natsu Matsuri] last: his double combo fires on its own every 4 actions. Give him your highest ATK.
Akira [June Bride] works from back-up: she clears Weak every turn. If your next skills remove no Weak effect, she also raises Lv1 cards to Lv2.

rows.label: Bought Nutcracker
why: Every No Org skill makes Nutcracker attack again for free, so four No Org units hit over and over.
All free except Nutcracker (came from the days 1–7 Wish Rebate, now closed). No Nutcracker? Use your best SSR.
From day 43 (shop listing, unconfirmed), Kiyoko can go in the back-up slot: +40% stats and a death save for every ally, in Stronghold Takeover only.
Source: research notes of October 26, 2026, section A6.

order.source: October 19 article "Meta teams", section 2 "Starter Team 1", "How to play it"; research notes of October 26, sections B3 (B-28) and D (D-07)
steps: Merge skill cards to Lv3 before you cast.
Sen first: her first skill makes your team immune to debuffs for one turn.
Rize [Binge Eater] and Kurona next: each cast fires Nutcracker's free 240% hit.
Nutcracker last, and only when no Toka [Maid Costume] holds Patience.
Naki heals from the back-up slot on his own: nothing to cast.

more: Guild tip: attacking a free tile with any team claims it, so a strong team spent there is a wasted attack.
Guild tip example: the opponent pushes and takes a tile; your one-character team on the free tile next to it grabs it.
Only the top 8 organizations in the Weekly Challenge can enter. The check is Saturday 10:00.
Each player brings 3 teams. You get 10 attack charges, plus 1 every 20 minutes. Spend them.

Lost HP comes back only slowly between fights (a win in a Hospital's area refunds 25% of the HP lost). Healing can't raise HP above the HP a unit started the fight with. Whether this hits defenders, attackers or both is unconfirmed. Either way, burst wins attacks.
A Police Station flips its whole area when you take it: the best free tile to grab.

Tower breakers to test on a stronghold that won't die: Shu [Mr.MM] or Toka [Anteiku] with Yakumo [Jason]. Shu needs 1★ for his damage cut and 3★ for his shield; Toka needs 1★ for lifesteal and 3★ for her death save. Meta: Black Rabbit with Miza or Naki [1.5th Anniversary]. (unconfirmed)
Practice in Takeover Simulation (Organization menu) before Saturday. (creator tip)
If the game refuses a 1-character team, make your tile team from your 5 weakest units.
Buy extra attack charges before you pay for revives: each of the first 9 charges costs less than one revive after the 5th.
NPC defenders switch off your passives for 1–2 turns. Bring skill burst.

Anteiku (Toka [Maid Costume], Yoshimura [Readiness], Toka [June Bride], Hinami [Hina Matsuri]; back-up Akira [June Bride]) was the October 19 article's best defense team. Creators called Anteiku weaker after the October 14 patch; with Hinami [Halloween] (October 25 on established servers, October 27 here per the owner), a creator (Aslan) expects all-Anteiku teams to be very hard to kill. (creator report)
Full rules, team counts and tips: Game modes › Stronghold Takeover.

meta.label: Meta
why: Toka [Maid Costume] counters each enemy active skill for 280% while she has Patience, and at 1★, above 50% HP, one hit can take at most 45% of her HP.
All Anteiku: Toka [Maid Costume] (1★) gives every Anteiku ally +30% stats.
Creators say the team needs Hinami: "without Hinami, it doesn't work at all."
Best for: Arena and Guild War defense against skill-heavy teams. One-Eyed Owl and Capture Simulation use Anteiku units.
Creators call Anteiku "struggling" after the October 14 patch. Swap: Ken [√A].
Creators don't name the Hinami version; [Hina Matsuri] is our best guess. (unconfirmed)
Source: October 19 article "Meta teams", section 1 "Meta C · Anteiku" and section 4 "Endgame team per faction".
meta.team_source: October 19 article "Meta teams", section 1 "Meta C · Anteiku" and section 4 "Endgame team per faction"

steps: Battle start is automatic: Toka [June Bride] casts a free Lv2 attack, and Hinami (1★) a free buff.
Yoshimura first: creators open the fight with him. His hit marks every enemy with Gash.
Hinami's buff next: +16.5% stats for the whole team for 2 turns.
Toka [June Bride]: 265% to all inside her Suppression Field.
Toka [Maid Costume] last: her real damage is the counter she fires at each enemy active skill. Give her your highest ATK.
Akira [June Bride] works from back-up.

Enji next: 260% to all, and Expose lowers their crit resistance for 2 turns.

Toka [Anteiku] last: a 420% hit that grows with the HP she has lost.
Naki heals from back-up.

why: Black Rabbit is DST, so he beats every attribute except another DST. His turn-start hit is not an active skill, so counters that answer active skills don't fire.
Miza strips shields and chips 10% of current HP (at most 100% of her own starting HP) at turn start, alongside Black Rabbit's hit.
Best for: Guild War attacks and Formidable Noro (he takes 50% less from non-Aogiri units).
Weak to: going second ("Aogiri is like the first one wins"). Black Rabbit and Miza are banned in Global Pinnacle Championship season 1 (creator report).

Naki's LR cell: creators say it gives your highest-ATK unit an extra attack. In the game text that is Naki [Prisoner]'s LR cell (it makes your highest-ATK Aogiri ally cast too); Naki [Crybaby]'s LR cell instead lowers the target's skill level in PvP. Check which cell you have.
Swaps: Noro for Miza; no Yakumo [Natsu Matsuri]? Use Hideyoshi or Eto in his place.
Creators don't name the Naki version; [Crybaby] is our best guess. (unconfirmed)

why: Black Rabbit is DST, so he beats every attribute except another DST. His turn-start hit is not an active skill, so counters that answer active skills don't fire.

Best for: Guild War attacks and Formidable Noro (he takes 50% less from non-Aogiri units).
Weak to: going second ("Aogiri is like the first one wins"). Black Rabbit and Miza are banned in Global Pinnacle Championship season 1 (creator report).

Naki's LR cell: creators say it gives your highest-ATK unit an extra attack. In the game text that is Naki [Prisoner]'s LR cell (it makes your highest-ATK Aogiri ally cast too); Naki [Crybaby]'s LR cell instead lowers the target's skill level in PvP. Check which cell you have.
Swaps: Noro for Miza; no Yakumo [Natsu Matsuri]? Use Hideyoshi or Eto in his place.
Creators don't name the Naki version; [Crybaby] is our best guess. (unconfirmed)

spotlight.title: Hinami [Halloween]: the new Anteiku support
spotlight.reported: The owner reports she is out on the NA relaunch server (October 27, 2026). On established servers her limited banner runs October 25 – November 8. Check the end date in game.
which: Which Hinami is new? Hinami [Halloween]. Her 1★ passive gives every Anteiku ally +50% ATK and +50% max HP, which matches "her 1★ passive for Anteiku seems really OP".

Hinami [Fledgling Butterfly] is also listed for the shop from server day 15 (unconfirmed), but her 1★ passive only boosts herself (above 80% HP: +30% healing, +20% damage). If your new Hinami is that one, send a screenshot of her skill page.
verdict: Spenders: yes, she is meta. She makes all-Anteiku teams much harder to kill and hit harder, and a creator (Aslan) expects these teams to be very hard to beat. (creator report)

Free players: only if you play Anteiku and can finish the 300 pulls (90,000 Diamonds). She drops at 1% per pull (fan datamine) and the 300th pull guarantees her, so finishing the banner usually gives 2 or more copies: about a 96% chance (estimate: 1 − 0.99^300 for a random copy, plus the two ~10% chests). Two copies make 1★ (standard star order, check in game). Keep your Panacean Star-Up Crystal for her only if you stop early; its item text says it works on "any entry-level SSR character".

Not Anteiku? Skip her: her big boosts (+50% ATK and max HP, Transcendence, Vitality stacks) only help Anteiku allies. Her healing cut, her battle-start buff and her own control immunity work in any team, but she is far weaker there.

We could watch only one creator review for this update (Aslan: a really good support). Other reviews exist on YouTube but were not checked, and the one we checked gives no free-to-play verdict. (creator report)
how: All allies +8% all stats (Lv3: +12% for 2 turns), and the next 2 active skills get +80% coefficient. Cast her first, then your biggest hitters.

With an all-Anteiku team she gets Transcendence at battle start: HP can't drop below 1 and +6% all stats for 1 turn. The first time another Anteiku ally takes fatal damage, it survives at 1 HP the same way, and all Anteiku allies get +30% damage for 1 turn.
Every Anteiku ally: +50% ATK and +50% max HP. Every enemy: −60% healing and −30% lifesteal. This is the passive that makes her meta. (1★ in the game's standard star order; check her star preview.)
She is immune to control and Weak, casts a free Lv2 active at battle start, and Anteiku allies build stacks toward a +100% active hit.

The healing cut hurts lifesteal and healer teams. To beat her team: kill a unit while her one-time save is used up, use instant big hits after the 1-turn effects end, or fight with units that don't rely on healing. (worked out from her skill text — not tested)
spotlight.patch: The SEA patch of October 23 limited Transcendence to the first fatal hit and 1 turn. If your server has the older text, she is even stronger. (fan datamine)

stars_guide.title: What each star gives
stars_guide.intro: Every unit follows the same 6-step pattern in the game's star preview. Passives unlock at 0★, 1★ and 3★.
steps: 0★ (first copy)
The active skill and the first passive.

Unlocks the second passive. For most units this is the biggest single upgrade, so 1★ is the first target for units you keep. Units on the "Invest short term" list and units rated C or D at full stars stay at 0★.
Adds a Weak effect: something that happens when this unit applies or suffers Weak.
Unlocks the third passive.
Adds a Power Burst effect, usually stats or damage when Power Burst triggers.
Basic stats greatly increased: the big stat jump.
Upgrades the active skill: its effect becomes an Ultra- version or gains a new effect. Passives don't change at 6★.
stars_guide.check: Checked against the game data: 1★ (second passive) and 5★ (big stat jump) are right, but 6★ upgrades only the active skill. Upgraded passives, like Hinami [Halloween]'s heal going from 10% to 15%, come from a separate gift upgrade, not from stars (fan datamine).
stars_guide.note: For 33 units the game data does not confirm which star unlocks each passive; their pages say so. Check the star preview in game.
materials: A star-up uses that unit's own Character Crystals or a Panacean Star-Up Crystal, which the item text says works on "any entry-level SSR character". New accounts get one Panacean from a login bonus.
Creators count one extra copy per star, so 6★ means the first copy plus 6 more. (creator report)
100 Panacean Star-Up Crystal Shards craft one crystal, and 100 Fragments of a unit craft a Guarantee Ticket for that unit.
Panacean Star-Up Crystals are scarce: Carnival 100-pull chests (24% in Season 1; Season 2's chest gives 12%) and the Revival Point Shop. Creators say never buy them with Diamonds. (creator tip)
Red Panaceas add stars; yellow Panacean Refinement Crystals raise the skill rating (D up to SSS) once a unit is starred. (creator report)
avoid: Don't put star-up items or Limit Crystals into units on the "Invest short term" list.
Shop units are the cheapest to star up, because the shop sells copies again. (creator tip)
Stop free units at 6★ and keep spare copies for the Crystal Exchange instead of pushing the skill rating. (creator tip)
Sources disagree on pulled units: one creator says go to 6★ or stay at one copy and never stop at 3–4★; the guide still puts 1★ first, because it unlocks a passive. (creator tip)
stars_guide.source: Star steps: game text RoleStarPreview_<id>_1 to 6 for all 142 units in the September 22, 2026 files (step 5 is "Basic Stats greatly increased" for every unit; step 6 always changes the active), GuideDialogue_StarUp_2 and 3, ItemDesc_20452, ItemDesc_21197, ItemDesc_20059 and LoginBonusTitle_New_5. payouts.name: Stronghold Takeover (Saturday guild war)
payouts.text: Holding a stronghold until its reward bar fills pays every member of the holding org 1,000, 2,000 or 3,000 Diamonds by stronghold tier, plus Cell Promoter. Final rank pays Carnival Summon Tickets and potentials. A creator calls the Diamond part low; the promoters and Panaceas are the real value. (creator report)
payouts.source: Game data (GVGTimeReward_1..3; final-rank rewards as in the Stronghold Takeover guide); creator video Aslan (September 23, 2026)

payouts.name: Global Stronghold War (Sundays)
payouts.text: The files have a 500-Diamond reward row for all participants and personal rank rewards of 300 to 800 Diamonds. Which rank pays which row is not in the data, and a creator says the mode pays few Diamonds while selling Diamond refills for points. (creator report)
payouts.source: Game data (AllRewardGlobalGVG_S1, GlobalGVGP rank rows); creator video Zeketta, September 23, 2026

payouts.name: Arena and Real-Time Arena
payouts.text: The files hold PvP season rewards of 60 to 360 Diamonds by grade (the lowest grade pays none), plus 100 to 2,000 PvP coins and a cell, and one-time rank rewards that add up to 4,255 Diamonds. They don't say whether these belong to Arena or Real-Time Arena; a creator reports 1,500 Diamonds for first reaching Arena rank 1, which matches the top one-time row. (our reading of the data)
payouts.source: Game data (PvpFinalR_G0_1..18, PvpMaxR rows); creator video Zeketta via the October 19 article

payouts.name: Carnival
payouts.text: The Carnival Support Project (server days 19–25, needs Chain Level 50) is a top-up ladder: spending real money there returns up to 187 Carnival tickets plus keys. Weekly Carnival quests pay about 2,000 Tokens and 1,050 Diamonds.
payouts.source: Game data (Act:LvReward_04, Season_Rebate_Task_01..20), as quoted in the research notes of October 26, 2026

vip.title: VIP: what it gives and where to stop
vip.intro: VIP levels come only from real-money top-ups. How much each level costs is not in the public data, so check the VIP screen in game. Wheel of Fortune purchases give no VIP points. (creator report)
verdict: Free players: VIP 0 works. Creators run free accounts at VIP 0 through server day 75. (creator report)

One creator reached VIP 6 with the monthly login contract plus growth funds, and says to stop at VIP 5: it adds sweeps and, by his account, the second Diamond Spring exchange (about +520 a day). Another creator puts that exchange at VIP 7, so check the VIP screen before you top up for it. (creator report)
Don't top up just for VIP. The daily VIP mail never pays Diamonds.
Big spenders: creators name no perk worth chasing between VIP 9 and 13; VIP 19 and up adds avatar borders and much bigger daily Limit Crystal mail. (creator report)

spend_split.title: Meta if you spend vs meta for free players
spend_split.intro: Why does the guide rate "weaker" units as meta? Because a free player can actually own and star them up.
why: The tier list rates each unit twice: at one copy ("At 0★") and fully starred ("At full stars").
Many top units keep their best passive behind 1★: Hinami [Halloween]'s +50% and Juzo [False Girl]'s +16% both need a second copy or a Panacean Star-Up Crystal, and Panaceans are scarce.
Banner and Carnival copies cost pulls. Shop units can be bought again, so free players star them up fast. (creator tip)
So the Starter and Mid teams use units you can really own and upgrade. An S unit you can't get, or can't star up, doesn't help your team.
Free player? Read banner units at "At 0★" and shop units at "At full stars".

buy_rules: Spending $0 is fine. These are October 19 prices: check the shop before you buy.
Banner value = Diamonds + 300 for each Event Summon Ticket. A ticket counts only on the banners it works on, so compare Diamonds and tickets separately (Tools page).
Buy inside a rebate window: Novice Rebate days 1–7, 8–14, 15–21 and 26–32; Carnival Support days 19–25; the Diamond Rebate (the best) days 34–55.
There is no Black Friday or Thanksgiving event in the game data, so don't wait for one.
